시편 108:1.content: A Song or Psalm of David. O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

시편 108:2.content: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

시편 108:3.content: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

시편 108:4.content: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

시편 108:5.content: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

시편 108:6.content: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

시편 108:7.content: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

시편 108:8.content: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

시편 108:9.content: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

시편 108:10.content: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

시편 108:11.content: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

시편 108:12.content: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

시편 108:13.content: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
